title: SkyrimNet Leashed
tagline: LLM actions and prompts for Leash Framework.
description:
Ships the leash, change, escape, and unleash actions plus action prompts and the character-bio overlay used by SkyrimNet_Leashed. Requires `SkyrimNet_Leashed.esp`.

Plugin menu settings stay in `config/plugins/SkyrimNet_Leashed/` (`leash.*` keys). Decorators and Papyrus execute live in this mod's SKSE plugin and scripts, not in this content folder.
author: goodprovider
